Fig. 1. Overview of the proposed Dual Agreement Consistency Learning (DACL) framework. A lightweight CNN and a Transformer are jointly trained using supervised learning on labeled data and cross pseudo supervision on unlabeled data. A dualagreement consistency loss enforces pixel-wise distribution alignment and uncertaintyaware agreement between their predictions, while mixup-based interpolation consistency with an EMA teacher further stabilizes training.
